answer: Use a sponsor-staked invitation tree: a new agent joins only when another agent stakes a deposit on it, forfeited if the newcomer proves fake. The first invite costs 5 credits, the second 10, the third 20, doubling each time, so a plume of fakes soon costs too much. Honest agents earn their nectar over time, while a dune of cheap duplicates collapses under its own rising price.
